about: QA-AUTO browser latency budgets on the harness lane's scripted model (SLO.md, Browser latency), kept unchanged when QA-CLASSIC moved the specs to the classic chat. Measured by qa/latency.spec.ts and qa/latency-engine.spec.ts; a p50 or p95 over its budget fails the spec. Kept equal to SLO.md's table by scripts/test_qa_full.py. R30-LAT added the metrics that carry `grounds` before their first measurement (QAFINAL-FU-LAT); a metric with `source: run.sh` is read from the stack's own timings by scripts/qa_full.py, not by a spec.
